01 / About

Curious About Biology.
Driven by Technology.

I am a B.Tech Biotechnology student at Lovely Professional University with a growing interest in healthcare, bioinformatics and cancer research. I enjoy exploring how technology and biological sciences can work together to create practical solutions with real-world impact.

My academic journey has allowed me to work across biotechnology, programming, electronics, healthcare applications and scientific communication. Through projects, hackathons, presentations and community initiatives, I have developed a practical and interdisciplinary approach to learning.

I am particularly interested in the emerging intersection of biotechnology with artificial intelligence and digital technologies, where computational thinking can complement biological knowledge to address complex healthcare challenges.

PROJECT 01 · 2025–2026

Arduino-Based Automatic Rain Wiper Sensor

Hardware · Automation · Embedded Systems

An Arduino-based automatic rain-sensing wiper system designed to detect rainfall in real time and automatically control wiper movement.

Integrated a rain sensor with Arduino UNO and an SG90 servo motor.
Programmed the system to classify rainfall into three intensity levels.
Automatically adjusted wiper operation according to rainfall intensity.
Designed to improve visibility and reduce manual intervention.

PROJECT 03 · 2025–2026

Living Medicines: Revolutionizing Cancer Treatment with Engineered Bacteria

Synthetic Biology · Cancer Research · Scientific Communication

A scientific exploration of engineered bacteria as a potential strategy for targeted cancer therapy, focusing on tumour-specific environments and controlled therapeutic action.

Researched the concept of engineered bacteria for targeted cancer treatment.
Explored tumour-specific environments and bacterial tumour colonization.
Contributed to scientific poster design and presentation.
Worked as part of a team-based academic project.
